Track the total number of unsaved Wounds inflicted by units with the Mark of Nurgle. At the start of each battle round, consult the Tally of Pestilence table to determine the current bonus. All models with the Mark of Nurgle gain the corresponding characteristic boost or special rule. All bonuses stack.
Models with the Mark of Nurgle gain +1 Strength.
Models with the Mark of Nurgle gain +1 Toughness.
Weapons with the "Poison" ability re-roll to wound rolls of 1.
Models with the Mark of Nurgle gain the "Warded" ability.
